purpose: How many bins have been checked, and when can the clerk stop?
meaning: Build a complete search trace for the chosen target, then reveal only its first k comparisons. The shown count is the smaller of k and the full trace length; the full-run cost is a separate quantity.

definition.setting: A workshop clerk checks eight numbered bins from left to right for a requested part code. Stop at the first match or after checking every bin.

examples.title: Find the requested middle code
examples.question: How many bins have been checked, and when can the clerk stop?
examples.setting: A workshop stores part codes 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14 and 16 in bins numbered 1 through 8. A clerk receives a requested code. Move the comparison step to follow the checks, or change the requested code and predict the next bin. The clerk checks bins from left to right and stops at the first match.
